title: Meningioma initiating cells (MICs) derived from primary tumors

publications.title: Isolation and characterization of a population of stem-like progenitor cells from an atypical meningioma.

needs_manual_review_reason: PER-GSM REVIEW COMPLETED (2026-07-10): this GSE contains 6 total samples across two platforms/parts. Part 1 (GPL6804, Affymetrix SNP array, this record's modality) has 4 samples, all from a single case labeled '1174': GSM560316 ('1174 DN2L condition cell line'), GSM560317 ('1174 Primary tumor tissue', the only genuine primary patient tissue sample), GSM560318 ('1174 primary xenograft tissue', characteristics list it as 'cell line: 1174 M1-R'), and GSM560319 ('1174 primary xenograft cell line in DN2L condition'). sample_count and patient_count above have been corrected to reflect only the SNP-array (cnv_snp_array) samples (4), all derived from the single patient/tumor case 1174 (patient_count=1); only 1 of the 4 is unmodified primary tissue, the rest are cell-line/xenograft-derived materials from that same tumor. Part 2 (GPL6947, Illumina gene-expression array, 2 samples: GSM563827 '1174 DN2L cell line' and GSM563828 'NSPC DN2L cell line') is a different assay/platform (not CNV/SNP data) and pure cell line (including a non-tumor neural stem/progenitor cell line control), and is excluded from this record's sample_count entirely. SCOPE DECISION MADE (2026-07-11): moved from /data/ to /data/adjacent/. Three of the 4 in-modality samples are cell-line/xenograft-derived, only 1 is genuine unmodified primary tissue, and the study's own title and design ('Meningioma initiating cells derived from primary tumors') frames this as a cell-derivation/model-system study, not a patient-cohort profiling study, the same category as this corpus's other cell-line/PDX adjacent records (e.g. gse-282349-bulk-rnaseq, gse-282351-methylation). A single remaining tissue sample from one patient was judged too thin a basis to represent a core CNV/SNP-array dataset entry on its own.
